China Cuisine Menu: A Journey Through Authentic Chinese Delights in North Reading

Welcome to China Cuisine, where we bring you the most authentic and delicious Chinese dishes in North Reading. Whether you’re craving a classic fried rice, a steaming bowl of soup, or a crispy chicken appetizer, our menu is sure to satisfy your every craving. With online ordering and delivery options, you can enjoy the best Chinese cuisine from the comfort of your own home. Explore our extensive menu, featuring a wide range of dishes including specials, vegetables, seafood, and so much more. Ready to discover the best of China cuisine? Let’s dive into what we offer!

Why Choose China Cuisine?

China Cuisine stands out as one of the best places to enjoy authentic Chinese food in North Reading. Our menu is crafted to offer you the finest selections, whether you’re in the mood for something light like a fresh appetizer or something hearty like our house special dishes. Our goal is to bring you the best Chinese food, made with high-quality ingredients and traditional cooking methods. Whether you’re ordering for a quick lunch special or a full meal, we promise a satisfying experience every time.

Our Menu – A Wide Range of Options

At China Cuisine, we’ve carefully curated our menu to cater to all tastes. From our signature fried rice to savory beef and pork dishes, there’s something for everyone.

Rice Dishes at China Cuisine

Rice is a staple in Chinese cuisine, and our menu features a variety of options to suit your preference. Whether you love fried rice loaded with shrimp or prefer steamed rice as a side to your meal, we’ve got you covered. Our fried rice is a perfect choice, stir-fried with your choice of chicken, shrimp, vegetables, or beef, and served with a touch of garlic for extra flavor.

  • Special Fried Rice: Packed with chicken, shrimp, and vegetables, our fried rice is a fan favorite.

  • Beef Fried Rice: Tender beef stir-fried with rice, egg, and vegetables.

  • Vegetable Fried Rice: A vegetarian delight, with stir-fried vegetables and egg.

Beef and Pork Specialties

Beef and pork are popular in Chinese cuisine, and our menu offers a variety of delicious dishes that will satisfy your cravings.

  • Beef with Broccoli: This classic dish features tender beef cooked with fresh broccoli in a savory brown sauce.

  • Sweet and Sour Pork: A crispy pork dish tossed in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, served with pineapple and bell peppers.

  • Boneless Spareribs: Deep-fried pork ribs with a touch of sweetness, perfectly crispy and satisfying.

Seafood Delights

For seafood lovers, our menu is packed with options that highlight the best of the ocean. From shrimp to crab, we have something to satisfy every seafood craving.

  • Shrimp with Garlic Sauce: Shrimp sautéed with garlic, snow peas, and a special sauce that enhances the natural sweetness of the shrimp.

  • Crab Rangoon: A delightful appetizer of crab, cream cheese, and wonton wrappers, deep-fried to perfection.

  • Sauteed Shrimp with Mushrooms: Shrimp cooked with mushrooms and ginger in a savory sauce.

Lunch Specials: Fast, Fresh, and Delicious

At China Cuisine, we understand that lunchtime can be busy. That’s why we offer quick and convenient lunch specials, perfect for a delicious meal during your workday. Choose from a variety of dishes like chicken wings, egg rolls, noodle soups, and more, all available for online ordering and delivery.

  • General Tso’s Chicken: A crispy chicken dish served with a sweet, tangy sauce, perfect for lunch.

  • Beef Teriyaki: Tender beef cooked in a sweet teriyaki sauce, served with steamed rice and a side of vegetables.

  • Egg Roll & Fried Rice Combo: A satisfying combination of crispy egg rolls and savory fried rice, perfect for a filling lunch.

Appetizers and Sides

Start your meal with one of our flavorful appetizers that complement your main dish. Choose from crispy chicken fingers, egg rolls, and our famous wonton soup. These sides are perfect for sharing or enjoying as a light snack.

  • Egg Rolls: Deep-fried wonton wrappers filled with seasoned meat and vegetables.

  • Spring Rolls: Fresh vegetables wrapped in a delicate wrapper, served with a tangy dipping sauce.

  • Crab Rangoon: Crispy wontons filled with crab and cream cheese, perfect for sharing.

Soups to Warm Your Soul

When the weather is chilly or you’re just craving something comforting, our selection of soups will hit the spot. From classic wonton soup to spicy hot and sour soup, we have something for every taste.

  • Wonton Soup: Soft wontons stuffed with savory filling, served in a warm broth.

  • Hot and Sour Soup: A flavorful broth with mushrooms, tofu, and a kick of spice.

  • Egg Drop Soup: A light and savory broth with egg ribbons, perfect for a light starter.

Vegetable and Tofu Dishes

For those who prefer a plant-based meal, our vegetable and tofu dishes are delicious and satisfying. Whether you’re looking for a stir-fried vegetable medley or a hearty tofu dish, we have something for you.

  • Sauteed Tofu with Mushrooms: Tender tofu stir-fried with mushrooms, peppers, and a savory sauce.

  • Vegetable Lo Mein: Soft noodles tossed with a medley of fresh vegetables in a light sauce.

  • Tofu with Snow Peas: A delightful dish featuring tofu and crisp snow peas sautéed in a light sauce.

Lo Mein and Noodles

Lo mein and noodles are a popular choice for those who crave something filling and flavorful. Our lo mein dishes are made with soft egg noodles stir-fried with your choice of chicken, shrimp, or vegetables. Pair them with a side of crispy spring rolls or a warm bowl of soup for a complete meal.

  • Chicken Lo Mein: Stir-fried egg noodles with chicken, vegetables, and a savory sauce.

  • Shrimp Lo Mein: Soft noodles tossed with succulent shrimp, mushrooms, and snow peas.

  • Vegetable Lo Mein: A vegetarian option with fresh vegetables and soft noodles, sautéed to perfection.

Order Online and Enjoy Delivery

Now that you know all about the delicious dishes we offer, why not take the next step and order online? With our easy-to-use website, you can browse our menu, select your favorite dishes, and have them delivered directly to your door. Whether you’re craving a quick lunch special, a comforting bowl of soup, or a full meal for the family, China Cuisine has you covered. Enjoy delivery straight to your home or office, so you can enjoy the best Chinese without ever leaving your space.
